a.content: Hi, my car insurance renewal letter came through and I want to check a few things before I decide. Policy for the Fiesta.

Hi, I can help. I can see your motor policy for the Ford Fiesta, registration ending KXF, renewing on 18 October at £486.40 for the year, up from £441.10 last year. It includes your 6 years' no claims discount, protected. What would you like to check?
the increase mostly, and a couple of other bits

Sure. The main reason is an industry-wide rise in repair and parts costs, which has pushed premiums up across the market rather than anything about you. Your details haven't changed and there are no claims on the policy. Happy to take your other questions too.
is it cheaper to pay all at once or monthly

Paying annually is cheaper. If you pay monthly we set up a credit agreement, which adds interest at a representative APR of 21.9%. On a policy this size that typically adds around 8-10% over the year. If you can pay in one go, it's better value.
wow didn't realise it was that much. I paid monthly last year I think
You did, yes, in 11 monthly instalments by direct debit. You can choose differently at renewal; nothing carries over automatically unless you leave it as it is.
if I leave it, does it just renew by itself?

Yes, the policy is set to auto-renew so you're never left without cover. If you don't contact us, it renews on the same payment method as last year. You can switch off auto-renewal at any time in your online account under Policy > Renewal preferences.
ok. and if I renew and then find something cheaper next week?

You'd have a 14-day cooling off period from the renewal date. Cancelling within that window gets you a refund for the unused days, less a £25 administration fee. After 14 days, cancelling costs £45 plus the time you've been on cover.
£25 isn't terrible
It's worth knowing, though, that if you're comparing quotes it's easier to do it before the renewal date, so there's no fee at all.
yeah fair. I'm rubbish at doing it in time though
You're definitely not alone. A reminder about three weeks before renewal is a good habit, as that's usually when quotes are lowest. Some insurers charge more for last-minute cover.
oh interesting why is that
Insurers' data suggests people who buy right before their cover starts are slightly higher risk on average, so some price that in. Quotes taken 20 to 27 days ahead tend to be cheapest.
I've got my contents insurance with you too but that's not up till April so that's fine
Yes, I can see that one renews on 2 April, so there's nothing to do on it now.
can I change the card the payments come from? my old one expired

Yes. Your online account has a card ending 7712 that expired in August. You can add the new one under Payments > Payment methods. I can't take card numbers in chat for security reasons, but our payments team can also do it by phone.
I'll do it online. what's the website login again, I always forget
It's my.covewell.co.uk. You log in with your email address and password; there's a reset link on the login page that sends a code to your mobile if you've forgotten it.
found it. do you send the documents by post or email
By email as standard, as PDFs attached to your renewal confirmation. You can download them any time from your online account too. If you need paper copies, we'll post them free of charge.
email is fine. can I add my partner's email so she gets them too

We can add a second email, but she'd need to be named on the policy or added as an authorised contact first, for data protection. If you give me her full name I can add her as an authorised contact, and she'd then be able to speak to us about the policy too.
maybe later, I'll ask her
No problem, you can do that any time.
how long does it take if I ever need to claim, roughly

Straightforward claims are usually settled within 10 working days of us having everything we need. More complex ones take longer, especially if an assessor is involved. You'd get a named claims handler and updates by text or email.
is there a helpline outside office hours
Yes, claims can be reported 24 hours a day on 0345 600 3381. The general enquiries team is available 8am to 8pm on weekdays and 9am to 5pm on Saturdays.

Most mid-term changes, like updating your address, are free. Some changes affect the premium, and if so we'd tell you the difference before anything's changed. We don't charge an admin fee for amendments.
